scientific_integrity: Analytic proofs and executable reproducibility checks are included; independent review and publication-priority adjudication have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-rest, isotropic, athermal harmonic-trap dynamics only; dimension limit precedes edge limits; lower-edge coefficient is a finite negative perpetuity moment; no closed density or simultaneous-limit estimate. Fixed-dimensional moments and coordinate boundary behavior were known; only the two-edge high-dimensional radial classification is assessed.
title: Sharp two-edge concentration laws for a high-dimensional run-and-rest swimmer
